responsibility: Implements the Layer-2 execution contract as a deterministic offline backend so the boundary has a real backend to prove replaceability against.
reads: the execution request handed to it through the port
execution_location: in-process adapter, no socket, no filesystem write, no subprocess
failure_boundary: fail_closed — an unverified token, an undeclared operation or an empty allowed scope refuses, and the backend performs no partial work before refusing
recovery_behavior: Deterministic and side-effect free, so re-running an identical authorized request yields an identical result hash and an interrupted run leaves nothing to clean up
replacement_contract: Any backend may replace this one by satisfying the port: consume a valid single-use capability, report only checks it actually performs, and be deterministic in semantic result hash; no caller above the port changes
evidence_produced: artifact_digest derived from the authorized request
evidence lines naming operation, scope, stopping condition and return point
